purpose: Exam matrix for every virtual worker before they can close work, teach others or change product rules.

global_exam_modules.name: Global Knowledge Core
global_exam_modules.pass_condition: Understands no proof no done, Parts Seller OS direction, public data safety, revenue/CFO/QA and anti-stagnation.

global_exam_modules.name: Proof-Based Execution
global_exam_modules.pass_condition: Can define owner, status, next_action, blocker, fallback, output_path and done_proof.

global_exam_modules.name: Parts Seller OS Workflow
global_exam_modules.pass_condition: Can explain add_part -> location -> price/floor -> listing status -> reserve/order -> ageing/dead-stock.

global_exam_modules.name: Public Data Provenance
global_exam_modules.pass_condition: Knows source_url, checked_at, confidence, allowed_use, dedupe and no mass scraping/bypass.

global_exam_modules.name: EU Seller Learning
global_exam_modules.pass_condition: Can extract reusable rules without copying content, catalogue, design or protected data.

global_exam_modules.name: Revenue Path
global_exam_modules.pass_condition: Knows seed target is not a lead; exact company/contact/offer/stage/next_action required.

global_exam_modules.name: CFO Margin Logic
global_exam_modules.pass_condition: Knows cost, build time, AI cost, delivery cost, price, gross margin and break-even.

global_exam_modules.name: QA/Judge Blocking
global_exam_modules.pass_condition: Can identify weak work, missing proof, bad listing readiness and release blockers.

global_exam_modules.name: Knowledge Sync
global_exam_modules.pass_condition: Can turn one project lesson into reusable rule and sync it to affected projects.

global_exam_modules.name: Anti-Duplication
global_exam_modules.pass_condition: Does not create duplicate roadmap/docs; routes work to existing task and proof path.

sample_questions.question: Can a worker mark a task done without a proof path?
sample_questions.correct_answer: No. No proof path means not done.

sample_questions.question: Can EU seller research copy catalogues or designs?
sample_questions.correct_answer: No. It can only extract reusable rules and patterns with source and confidence.

sample_questions.question: What is the core Parts Seller OS flow?
sample_questions.correct_answer: dalis -> kaina -> lokacija -> skelbimas -> užsakymas, with QA, CFO, delivery and learning feedback.

sample_questions.question: When can a data row influence pricing?
sample_questions.correct_answer: Only when it has source_url, checked_at, confidence and allowed_use.

sample_questions.question: What happens when 10000 workers find the same issue?
sample_questions.correct_answer: They dedupe into one canonical task/output path and attach review, QA or unblock support.
